household_message.text: Going out tonight from 6 to 10. Car at 70% by 6 and the washing finished by half five.

message_to_household: I will plan the car charge and the washing machine for you, but I need to clarify a few points first.

questions.text: You asked to charge the car to 70 % by 20:00 tonight. Is this the usual target (80 %) or should I charge only to 70 %?
You asked for the washing machine to finish by 05:30 tomorrow. Is this the usual deadline (by 07:30) or should I run it earlier?
You asked to go out from 20:00 to 22:00 tonight. Is this the usual away period (e.g. every evening) or just tonight?
